worldcombat.skill.peck.summary: Quickly peck a nearby target. Deals extra damage to airborne enemies and pulls them toward the ground.
worldcombat.skill.peck.use.0: A fast, cheap single jab at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.peck.use.1: Drive an airborne target back down to the ground
worldcombat.skill.peck.use.2: Snatch a quick jab before the foe starts its move
worldcombat.skill.peck.description.0: The beak point deals about %1$s contact damage.
worldcombat.skill.peck.description.1: It first steps in up to %3$s blocks, then jabs along a narrow lane about %1$s blocks long with a %2$s block radius, hitting only the first enemy in it.
worldcombat.skill.peck.description.2: A grounded target gets no bonus; an airborne one takes %1$s times the damage and is driven down at %2$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.peck.dive.on: Dive form: the whole body lunges in — reach about %1$s blocks and about %2$s damage per jab, but a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.peck.dive.off: Jab form: a quick peck on the spot, reach about %1$s blocks and about %2$s damage, with the shortest wind-up and cycle so it can be thrown repeatedly.
worldcombat.skill.peck.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.peck.growth.0: At level %1$s each jab rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.peck.growth.1: At level %1$s each jab rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.peck.preference.dive.h: On (dive): forward step ×1.9, reach ×1.18, power ×1.1 and airborne bonus +0.1, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up, +2 of recovery and +5 of cooldown. Off (jab): a quick peck on the spot with slightly less reach and power but the shortest wind-up and cycle.
